name: serif-manifesto
vibe: The only pack in this set with no image slots at all — it is typography and nothing else. An ivory #f6f1e7 page, ink #1e1b17 text, oxblood #7a2e2e and a gold #b08d3f hairline for emphasis. Playfair Display sets the hook centred and low on the page with Lato beneath it. The world is almost still: a 2px rule hanging from the top edge to a small oxblood dot, an italic asterism near the foot, and a band of 400px outline italic 'Aa' at 10% opacity drifting left at 24 pixels a second. The camera barely breathes and titles use an unusually soft entrance. Mechanics: a typewriter, a cross-fade morph, a page flip and a numbered maxim list. Best for essays, publishers, law and consultancy, book launches and brand manifestos.

assets.photoMod: quiet natural-light still life photograph of an open book on ivory paper, warm side light and deep shadow, the grain of a 35mm film scan

cta.note: the CTA logo lockup — this pack is typographic and shows no other imagery

audio.mood: A quiet reading room — one idea at a time, with space left between the sentences
